description: Produce a dated public-carrier evidence record for a human reviewer. Prefer an exact USDOT; existing MC and name inputs remain supported, with name matches requiring manual identity confirmation. Returns allowlisted FMCSA facts, explicit missing/unavailable source states, field dates separate from retrieval time, deterministic official source links, and separate human follow-up tasks. Export markdown (default), JSON, or printable HTML. No safety/booking verdict or verified-insurance claim; unavailable data is never a clean result.

format.description: Record export format; HTML is a standalone printable document, not a hosted link.

name.description: Legal carrier name when DOT/MC is unavailable.

name: carrier_vetting_evidence_pack
